accepted.title: Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration
accepted.first_author_affiliation: Kim Jaechul Graduate School of AI, KAIST
accepted.scope: Integral DeltaNet保留fast delta state并新增其历史积分state；按key channel分别控制积分速度和当前/历史读出，积分state不反向改变delta更新。

cost_basis.available_resource: one A100 or A30,or local Mac
cost_basis.paper_configuration: §4主矩阵为340M/1.3B非embedding参数，从头训练15B/100B FineWeb-Edu tokens，4K序列、0.5M-token global batch；多个backbone及额外15B-token门/state消融。B300训练/解码效率测量亦非A100原样配置。完整训练矩阵明显超本轮单A100/A30或Mac预算；这是已发表模型/token配置的成本判断，未测本地完整时长，不编造GPU小时。
cost_basis.estimated_cost_basis: Published model/token/platform/evaluation matrix; no local full run or invented GPU hours. CPU component only,no model/data downloads.
cost_basis.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；完整实验终态，局部CPU L1另行验收

accepted.title: DeCo-Attention: Decompose to Compensate for Low-Precision Attention
accepted.scope: DeCo在runtime逐head估计主子空间，用Q侧和K侧一阶残差投影构造额外通道，让一个扩展QK点积带入两侧补偿；额外通道同样量化。
